name: Imam Darto
bio: Haji Imam Hendarto "Darto" Sukarno (born in Jakarta, 12 November 1982) is an Indonesian host known in the television show The Comment on NET. and as the broadcaster of the Dandees program on Prambors radio. However, he resigned from Prambors with his colleague Dimas Danang in December 2015. And is known as Pablo Estefan Zaragoza.
